name: Kosmos-656
about: Kosmos-656 (1974-036A), a crewed vehicle (7K-TA), launched 1974 May 27. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1974 May 28), held fixed
GCAT names the site (-) without coordinates; the point is a stand-in

events.why: GCAT gives the launch without an hour
